title: Gazyva is first FDA-cleared drug for rare disease pMN | pharmaphorum

summary:

: November 16, 2026
Source:
: Max Planck Institute for Biology of Ageing
Summary:
: Scientists discovered that vitamin B12 largely reversed developmental abnormalities in worms carrying a genetic mutation linked to Verheij syndrome, a rare disorder that causes growth problems and developmental delays.
